properties.notes: Demolition of 4 no. residential units and refurbishment and external alterations of neighbourhood centre, change of use of existing A1 (shop), B1/B8 (Former Council Estate Office, Business and Storage), D1 (Community Centre) and ancillary Community Cafe to create 3 no. units comprising 2no. Class A1 (shop) and 1no. Class B1 (business) at ground floor level, construction of one additional floor to create 12 no. one bedroom apartments and 10 no. two bedroom flats.
